name: Shrubby saltbush
desc: A salt-tolerant shrub, named as a climax plant of the Syrian steppe, and a mainstay of grazing land.
about: Caroxylon vermiculatum, commonly known as Mediterranean saltwort, is a perennial plant in the family Amaranthaceae. It has many synonyms, including Salsola vermiculata and Nitrosalsola vermiculata.
